mission.title: dify: After upgrading to v1.0.0, it is unable to have normal conversations and perform embeddings
mission.description: After upgrading to v1.0.0, it is unable to have normal conversations and perform embeddings. This issue affects 7+ users.

steps.title: Identify dify troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:

```bash
docker compose version
docker compose ps
```
